changed: Dances you import from The Caller's Box read two more kinds of line as figures instead of text: "Men go forward" followed by "Men bring back partner" is one give and take, and "Men balance long wave in center" on its own line is a balance, noted as in a long wave in the center.

The Caller's Box adapter folds a `<role> go forward` / `<role> bring back partner|neighbor` pair into `give_and_take`, and reads a `<role> balance long wave in center` line that nothing else claimed as `balance` with a `long wave in center` note.
